package.name: kims
package.description: KIMS: Kinematic-Constrained MPPI Smoothing for UWB-IMU 6-DoF Pose Estimation. Offline evaluation of KIMS and the EKF-RTS, UKF-RTS, Particle Smoothing and SW-MAP baselines on MILUV, NTU VIRAL and IULUI, plus a real-time ROS node. The offline tools read CSV and build without ROS.
